body.name: Fully specified quantized core experiment
body.construction: Restrict a binary component record to \(X\in\bigcup_{j=1}^kC_j\) and apply \(q_{\mathrm{core}}(Y,A,X)=(j,2A-1,2Y-1)\). Equivalently, conditional on \((s,\lambda)\), draw \(J\) uniformly from \(\{1,\ldots,k\}\) and then draw \((U,V)\) with \(Q_{s,\lambda}^{(k)}\{(j,u,w)\}=(4k)^{-1}(1+2a\lambda_ju+2sb\lambda_jw)\). For two records retain the same \(\lambda\) and average it uniformly to obtain \(\overline\Pi_{s,k}^{\,2}\). The sample space is \(\mathcal Z_k^2\), the collision event is \(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{coll}}=\{J_1=J_2\}\), and replacement adjacency is \(\sim_{\mathrm q}\).
